business_model.claim: GSL owns a fleet of mid-sized and smaller containerships and earns revenue by chartering them out under fixed-rate time charters to container shipping companies.

business_model.basis: Stated explicitly in the Risk Factors section of the 20-F.
business_model.claim: Charter payments from time charters are GSL's sole source of operating cash flow.

business_model.basis: Stated in the MD&A discussion of 2025 vs. 2024 operating revenues.
business_model.claim: Operating revenues of $766.5 million in 2025 rose 7.8% year-over-year, driven by higher rates on charter renewals, net fleet additions, a $4.8 million straight-lining effect, and an $8.0 million increase in amortization of intangible liabilities from below-market charters.
quotes: The increase in operating revenue was mainly due to (i) the net effect of higher rates on charter renewals (ii) the addition of the 2024 Acquired Vessels, the addition of two of the Newly Acquired Vessels offset by the sale of Tasman, Keta, and Akiteta in the first quarter of 2025 and the sale of Dimitris Y in the fourth quarter of 2025, (iii) a non-cash $4.8 million positive effect from straight lining time charter modifications, and (iv) a non-cash $8.0 million increase in the amortization of intangible liabilities arising from below market charters attached to certain vessel additions offset by an increase in off hire days.

business_model.basis: Stated in the MD&A revenue discussion.
business_model.claim: Utilization was 95.6% in 2025, with 1,125 days of offhire and idle time of which 816 were for scheduled drydockings.
quotes: There were 1,125 days of offhire and idle time in the year ended December 31, 2025 of which 816 were for scheduled drydockings, compared to 966 days of offhire and idle time in the prior year of which 807 were for scheduled drydockings.

business_model.basis: Stated in the MD&A cost discussion.
business_model.claim: Vessel operating expenses were $208.4 million (27.2% of operating revenues) in 2025, the largest single operating cost, with an average cost per ownership day of $8,231.
quotes: Vessel operating expenses, which relate to the operation of the vessels themselves, were $208.4 million for the year ended December 31, 2025 (or 27.2% of operating revenues) compared to $191.4 million for the year ended December 31, 2024 (or 26.9% of operating revenues).
The average cost per ownership day for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $8,231, compared to $7,670 for the prior year period, up $560 per day, or 7.3%.

business_model.claim: As of December 31, 2025, the average remaining charter term was 2.7 years on a TEU-weighted basis, and contracted revenue on that basis was $2.24 billion.
quotes: As of December 31, 2025, including the three 8,586 TEU, Korean-built containerships delivered on various dates in December 2025 and the third one, Cypress, on January 9, 2026, and all charters agreed during 2025 and through February 28, 2026, the average remaining term of our charters, to the mid-point of redelivery, including options under our control and other than if a redelivery notice has been received, was 2.7 years on a TEU-weighted basis.
Contracted revenue on the same basis was $2.24 billion.

business_model.basis: Stated in the Risk Factors section of the 20-F.

business_model.basis: Stated in the MD&A Liquidity and Capital Resources section.
